title: ConstantPullbackCompositionCoherence
statement:
Let $X,Y,Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $u:X\to Y$, $v:Y\to Z$, and $M$ an abelian group. Write $M_T$ for the constant sheaf on the small etale site of $T$ [def-constructible-constant], and $u^{-1},v^{-1}$ for the inverse images [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $c_u:M_X\xrightarrow{\sim}u^{-1}M_Y$ be the inverse of the constant-sheaf comparison: it is defined by uniqueness of the left adjoints to global sections, after identifying global sections of a direct image with global sections on the source [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Define $c_v,c_{uv}$ in the same way. Let $a_{u,v}:(uv)^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}u^{-1}v^{-1}$ be the inverse-image comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition], in this direction. Then the following equality holds in the category of abelian sheaves on $X$, before applying cohomology:
$$a_{u,v,M_Z}\circ c_{uv}=u^{-1}(c_v)\circ c_u:M_X\longrightarrow u^{-1}v^{-1}M_Z.$$

proof.text: The constant-sheaf functor is left adjoint to global sections by [def-constructible-constant]. Compose that adjunction on Z with the inverse-image adjunctions for v and u [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Global sections of direct image are sections on the source [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]; the right-adjoint comparisons use the pullback-pasting isomorphism, which identifies the terminal base-change objects with the terminal object of X.

The isomorphism a_{u,v} has the unit compatibility of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Under the composed adjunctions, the map a_{u,v,M_Z} after c_{uv} has adjoint the unit of constant sheaf at M: the unit equation converts the composite inverse-image unit into the two successive units. The map u^{-1}(c_v) after c_u has the same adjoint by the defining unit equations of c_u and c_v and the formula for the unit of a composite adjunction. The terminal pullback-pasting identifications on sections are the same: both are induced by the unique maps between the terminal base-change objects. Injectivity of the adjunction bijection, equivalently uniqueness in [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation], equates the two sheaf morphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem constantPullbackCompositionCoherence {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (u : X ⟶ Y) (v : Y ⟶ Z) (M : AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (u ≫ v)).inv.app M) ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} u v).hom.app
          ((constantSheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj M) =
      (Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} u).inv.app M ≫
        ((u)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).map
          ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} v).inv.app M)
